study: Vernon-Feagans et al. (2013), Targeted Reading Intervention (TRI) — live-webcam literacy coaching for K-1 teachers of struggling readers, J. Educ. Psychology
eval_evidence: Conducted/authored by the research team that developed the TRI (NRCRES, IES grant R305A040056); the program was 'developed by' this team and evaluated by them. Developer-conducted, not an independent third party.
developer_evidence: 'The intervention director of the project and the trained reading coaches led the 3-day summer institute' and delivered the biweekly webcam coaching; the project's own literacy coaches (research staff) delivered the PD to teachers.
cascade_evidence: Project literacy coaches (research-team staff) coached the classroom teachers directly via live webcam; the intervention director trained the coaches, who worked one-on-one with teachers. No school-based lead-teacher cascade -> developer_direct.
counterfactual_evidence: Control = struggling readers in non-intervention control schools (SRC) under business-as-usual instruction; control schools received no TRI materials, training, or coaching. Standard BAU contrast.
coaching_evidence: Core model is 'ongoing biweekly coaching' delivered via live webcam: coaches observed and gave the teacher real-time feedback during her TRI sessions in her own classroom, ~30 min biweekly throughout the year -> recurring in-class coaching cycles (biweekly) -> frequent_inclass.
student_dose_evidence: TRI adds a direct student-facing dose: the teacher delivers one-on-one TRI sessions to each struggling reader for '15 min a day' in the classroom (each target child got ~14 individualized sessions), on top of regular instruction. Outcomes are measured on these struggling readers who received the 1-on-1 tutoring -> student_component.
maturity_evidence: TRI delivered over a single treatment year with one immediate spring post-test wave; teachers/coaches new to the program, no multi-year rollout or maturity axis -> single_year_design (also consistent with first_year framing; coded single_year_design as the program is a one-year delivery).
